([[Raleigh, North Carolina]]) | college = * [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]] (2024–2025) * [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] (2025–2026) | highlights = * Big 12 All-Defensive Team (2025) * [[Big 12]] All-Freshman Team (2025) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2024]]) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Americas Under-16 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2023 FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship|2023 Mexico]]|[[United States men's national under-17 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Jayden Quaintance''' (born July 11, 2007) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State Sun Devils]] and [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky Wildcats]].{{Cite web |date=2025-04-08 |title=Quaintance commits to Kentucky for 2nd time |url=https://www.espn.com/espngamer/ncb/story/_/id/44586018/ex-arizona-state-star-jayden-quaintance-re-commits-kentucky |access-date=2025-04-08 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Early life and high school== Quaintance grew up in [[Cleveland, Ohio]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cleveland.com/highschoolsports/2022/09/cvcas-darryn-peterson-cleveland-native-jayden-quaintance-invited-to-usa-basketball-junior-national-team-camp.html|title=CVCA's Darryn Peterson, Cleveland native Jayden Quaintance invited to USA Basketball Junior National Team minicamp|first=Matt|last=Goul|website=[[Cleveland.com]]|date=September 22, 2022|access-date=March 21, 2024}} He moved to [[Phoenix, Arizona]] before the start of high school and enrolled at Hillcrest Prep.{{cite web|url=https://duckswire.usatoday.com/lists/dana-altman-extends-offer-to-4-star-center-jayden-quanintance-in-class-of-2025/|title=Dana Altman extends offer to 4-star center Jayden Quanintance in class of 2025|first=Andy|last=Patton|website=Ducks Wire|publisher=[[USA Today]]|date=October 12, 2022|access-date=March 21, 2024}} Quaintance transferred again to [[Word of God Christian Academy]] in [[Raleigh, North Carolina]] before his sophomore year.{{cite web|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article278609154.html|title=More five-star recruits set visits to Kentucky basketball, and other UK recruiting news.|first=Cameron|last=Drummond|work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]|date=August 29, 2023|access-date=April 6, 2024}} He also reclassified from the class of 2025 to 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.on3.com/teams/kentucky-wildcats/news/jayden-quaintance-talks-reclass-decision-kentucky-offer-it-seems-like-a-good-fit/|title=Jayden Quaintance talks reclass decision, Kentucky offer: "It seems like a good fit"|first=Jack|last=Pilgrim|website=On3.com|date=July 29, 2023|access-date=April 6, 2024}} Quaintance was selected to play in the [[2024 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]] during his senior year.{{cite web|url=https://www.kentucky.com/sports/college/kentucky-sports/uk-recruiting/article287295200.html|title=McDonald's All-American Game featured three future Kentucky players. Here's who impressed.|first=Cameron|last=Drummond|work=[[Lexington Herald Leader]]|date=April 3, 2024|access-date=April 6, 2024}} ===Recruiting=== Quaintance was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the top players in the 2024 class, according to major recruiting services.{{cite web|url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2023/08/07/native-ohioan-jayden-quaintance-considering-ohio-state-in-2024-class/70540034007/|title=Five-star native Ohioan Jayden Quaintance considering Ohio State in 2024 class|first=Adam|last=Jardy|work=[[The Columbus Dispatch]]|date=August 7, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}}{{cite web|url=https://www.columbiamissourian.com/sports/mizzou_mens_basketball/top-10-prospect-quaintance-lists-mizzou-as-finalist/article_67eab1ae-8005-11ee-8011-57c8a0a78ac8.html|title=Top-10 prospect Quaintance lists Mizzou as finalist|first=Christian Riley|last=Dutcher|work=[[Columbia Missourian]]|date=November 10, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}} He committed to play college basketball at Kentucky over offers from Missouri, Florida, South Florida, and Ohio State.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/38896975/kentucky-improves-recruiting-class-jayden-quaintance|title=Kentucky improves recruiting class with Jayden Quaintance|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=November 14, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}} Quaintance signed a [[National Letter of Intent]] (NLI) to play for the Wildcats on November 15, 2023, during the early signing period.{{cite web|url=https://www.aseaofblue.com/2023/11/15/23963207/jayden-quaintance-travis-perry-kentucky-wildcats-basketball|title=Jayden Quaintance and Travis Perry officially sign with Kentucky|first=Adam|last=Haste|website=ASeaOfBlue.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=November 15, 2023|access-date=April 11, 2024}} However, he requested a release from his NLI on April 10, 2024, shortly after Kentucky head coach [[John Calipari]] left the program to become the head coach at [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]].{{cite web|url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2024/apr/10/5-star-center-requests-release-from-kentucky-nli/|title=5-star center requests release from Kentucky NLI|work=[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]]|date=April 10, 2024|access-date=April 11, 2024}} On April 29, 2024, Quaintance announced his commitment to [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]]. == College == Quaintance played one season with Arizona State, playing 24 games and averaging 9.4 points and 7.9 rebounds per game.{{Cite web |title=Jayden Quaintance College Stats |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/jayden-quaintance-1.html |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} In February 2025, he injured his knee and missed the remainder of the season. He had knee surgery on March 19.{{Cite web |date=2025-04-02 |title=ASU's Quaintance has knee surgery, eyes portal |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/44504710/arizona-state-jayden-quaintance-knee-surgery-eyes-portal |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Following the season, he entered the [[NCAA transfer portal|transfer portal]].{{Cite web |date=2025-04-02 |title=Why Jayden Quaintance, Arizona State's star 17-year-old, is the most unique transfer portal entrant ever |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/why-jayden-quaintance-arizona-states-star-17-year-old-would-be-the-most-unique-transfer-portal-entrant-ever/ |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}} He later announced he would transfer to Kentucky, where he had originally committed to play his freshman year.{{Cite web |last=O'Reilly |first=Alexander |date=2025-05-07 |title=Mark Pope's latest transfer portal addition, Jayden Quaintance sends clear message ahead of first season with Kentucky |url=https://www.sportskeeda.com/college-basketball/news-mark-pope-s-latest-transfer-portal-addition-jayden-quaintance-sends-clear-message-ahead-first-season-with-kentucky |access-date=2025-05-19 |website=www.sportskeeda.com |language=en-us}} ==National team career== Quaintance played for the [[United States men's national under-17 basketball team|United States national under-16 team]] at the 2023 [[FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship]]. He averaged 6.7 points and 6.5 rebounds in six games as the United States won the gold medal.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/recruiting/basketball/story/_/id/39915633/sources-jayden-quaintance-wants-kentucky-commitment|title=Sources: Jayden Quaintance wants out of Kentucky commitment|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|website=[[ESPN.com]]|date=April 10, 2024|access-date=April 12, 2024}} ==Personal life== Quaintance's father, Haminn Quaintance, played college basketball at Jacksonville and Kent State.{{cite web|url=https://www.dispatch.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2023/09/11/ohio-state-official-visit-surprised-jayden-quaintances-family/70824348007/|title=Ohio State official visit surprised Jayden Quaintance's family|first=Adam|last=Jardy|work=[[The Columbus Dispatch]]|date=September 11, 2023|access-date=March 21, 2024}} In his free time, Quaintance enjoys playing chess and watching [[anime]]. His favorite anime is ''[[One Piece]]''. {{Cite web |date=2025-07-11 |title=Jayden Quaintance |url=https://ukathletics.com/roster/jayden-quaintance/ |access-date=2025-12-28 |website=UK Athletics |language=en-US}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://ukathletics.com/sports/mbball/roster/season/2025-26/player/jayden-quaintance/ Kentucky Wildcats bio] *[https://thesundevils.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/jayden-quaintance/16641 Arizona State Sun Devils bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Quaintance, Jayden}} [[Category:2007 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Cleveland]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:Word of God Christian Academy alumni]]
